H0647.name: Aphiah
H0647.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0647.brief: Ancestor of King Saul, a Benjamite
H0647.short: Aphiah, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul, the first king of Israel.

H0649.name: Appaim
H0649.brief: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah
H0649.short: Appaim was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H0690.name: Ara
H0690.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0690.brief: Son of Jether, descendant of Asher
H0690.short: Ara was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H0692.name: Areli
H0692.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0692.brief: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob
H0692.short: Areli, a son of Gad, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jacob and the census of the Israelites in the wilderness.

H0609H.name: Asa
H0609H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H0609H.brief: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem
H0609H.short: Asa was a Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.16">1Ch.9.16</ref>).

H0609G.name: Asa
H0609G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0609G.brief: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat
H0609G.short: Asa was a king of Judah who reigned for 41 years, known for his religious reforms (1Kings 15; 2Chr 14-16).

H0623G.name: Asaph
H0623G.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0623G.brief: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

H0623I.name: Asaph
H0623I.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H0623I.brief: Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem
H0623I.short: Asaph was a Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17">1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17</ref>).

H0623H.name: Asaph
H0623H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0623H.short: Asaph served as the recorder during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22">2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22</ref>).

H0623J.name: Asaph
H0623J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0623J.brief: Keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time
H0623J.short: Asaph was the keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.2.8">Neh.2.8</ref>).

H0621.name: Asenath
H0621.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0621.brief: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim
H0621.short: Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, was given to Joseph as his wife by Pharaoh (<ref="Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20">Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20</ref>).

H0619.name: Asnah
H0619.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0619.brief: Head of a family of temple servants who returned from exile
H0619.short: Asnah was the head of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile (<ref="Ezra 2:50">Ezra 2:50</ref>).
H0619.meaning: “I shall be hated: she has stored up”

forms.meaning: “I shall be hated: she has stored up”

H0630.name: Aspatha
H0630.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0630.brief: One of the ten sons of Haman
H0630.short: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were executed after their father's downfall (<ref="Est.9.7">Est.9.7</ref>).

H0617H.name: Assir
H0617H.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0617H.brief: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel
H0617H.short: Assir was a Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet (<ref="1Ch.6.23">1Ch.6.23, 37</ref>).

H0617G.name: Assir
H0617G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0617G.brief: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath
H0617G.short: Assir was a son of Korah and great-grandson of Kohath, from the tribe of Levi (<ref="Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22">Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22</ref>).

H0683.name: Azaliah
H0683.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0683.brief: Father of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign
H0683.short: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, who served during the reign of King Josiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8">2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8</ref>).

H0682A.name: Azel
H0682A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0682A.brief: Descendant of Saul, had six sons
H0682A.short: Azel, a descendant of Saul, had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan (<ref="1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44">1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44</ref>).

H0654.name: Ephlal
H0654.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0654.brief: Son of Zabad, in the genealogy of Judah.
H0654.short: Ephlal was the son of Zabad, who was a descendant of Judah through Jerahmeel.

H0641.name: Ephod
H0641.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0641.brief: A leader from the tribe of Manasseh.
H0641.short: Ephod son of Hanniel was appointed as the leader from the tribe of Manasseh to assist in dividing the land of Canaan.

H0669G.name: Ephraim
H0669G.desc: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0669G.brief: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.
H0669G.short: Ephraim was the second son of Joseph, and his descendants formed one of the twelve tribes of Israel, often playing a prominent role in the nation's history.
H0669G.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H0672G.name: Ephrathah
H0672G.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0672G.brief: A wife of Caleb and founder of Bethlehem.
H0672G.short: Ephrathah (through her son Hur or grandon Salma) was the founder of Bethlehem.

H0634.name: Esarhaddon
H0634.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0634.brief: King of Assyria; son and successor of Sennacherib.
H0634.short: Esarhaddon was the king of Assyria, the son and successor of Sennacherib.

H0635.name: Esther
H0635.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H0635.brief: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.
H0635.short: Esther, also known as Hadassah, was a Jewish queen of Persia who saved her people from genocide.

H0675H.name: Ezbon
H0675H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0675H.brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
H0675H.short: Ezbon was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.
H0675H.meaning: “hasting to discern: I will be enlargement”

forms.meaning: “hasting to discern: I will be enlargement”

H0675G.name: Ezbon
H0675G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0675G.brief: Son of Gad; head of the Oznite clan.
H0675G.short: Ezbon, also known as Ozni, was a son of Gad and the head of the Oznite clan.
H0675G.meaning: “hasting to discern: I will be enlargement”

forms.meaning: “hasting to discern: I will be enlargement”

H0687.name: Ezer
H0687.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0687.brief: Horite chief in Seir; son of Seir the Horite.
H0687.short: Ezer was a Horite chief in the land of Seir, a son of Seir the Horite.

H0620.name: Osnappar
H0620.desc: King living at the time of Exile and Return
H0620.brief: Assyrian king who settled people in Samaria
H0620.short: Osnappar (probably Ashurbanipal) was an Assyrian king who brought people from various regions and settled them in Samaria.

H0684G.name: Ozem
H0684G.desc: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
H0684G.short: Ozem was one of David's brothers, a son of Jesse.

H0684H.name: Ozem
H0684H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0684H.short: Ozem was a son of Jerahmeel and a nephew of Caleb.

H0663I.name: Aphek
H0663I.brief: A city in the north, site of Aramean battles.
H0663I.short: Aphek, a city in the north, where the Arameans fought against Israel.

H0663G.name: Aphek
H0663G.brief: A city in the Shephelah, site of Philistine battles.
H0663G.short: Aphek or Aphekah, a city in the Shephelah, known for Philistine conflicts with Israel.

H0663H.name: Aphek
H0663H.brief: A city in the territory of Asher.
H0663H.short: Aphek, a city allotted to the tribe of Asher.

H0694.name: Arab
H0694.brief: A city allotted to the tribe of Judah.
H0694.short: Arab, a town in the hill country of Judah.

H0682B.name: Azal
H0682B.brief: Unidentified place near Jerusalem mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy.
H0682B.short: Azal was an unidentified place near Jerusalem mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy. (<ref="Zechariah 14:5">Zechariah 14:5</ref>)

H0658.name: Ephes-dammim
H0658.brief: Place where the Philistines and Israelites fought; Goliath's challenge
H0658.short: Ephes-dammim (or Pas-dammim), the place where the Philistines and Israelites faced each other in battle, and where Goliath challenged the Israelites.

H0669L.name: Ephraim
H0669L.brief: City near the Judean wilderness; Jesus withdrew there
H0669L.short: Ephraim, a city near the Judean wilderness where Jesus withdrew after the raising of Lazarus.
H0669L.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H0669H.name: Ephraim Gate
H0669H.brief: Gate in Jerusalem's wall, broken down by King Jehoash
H0669H.short: The Ephraim Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall that was broken down by King Jehoash of Israel during his conflict with King Amaziah of Judah.
H0669H.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H0669I.name: Ephraim Gate
H0669I.brief: Gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt during Nehemiah's time
H0669I.short: The Ephraim Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall that was rebuilt during Nehemiah's time and used for public gatherings and proce∟ssions.
H0669I.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H0669K.name: Forest Ephraim
H0669K.brief: Location of the battle between David's forces and Absalom's army
H0669K.short: The Forest of Ephraim, where the battle between David's forces and Absalom's army took place during Absalom's rebellion.
H0669K.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H0671A.name: Apharasthchite
H0671A.brief: Apharsathchites: A group opposing the rebuilding of Jerusalem's temple
H0671A.short: The Apharsathchites were a group that opposed the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezra 4:9; 5:6; 6:6">Ezra 4:9; 5:6; 6:6</ref>).
H0671A.meaning: “as causers of division (?)” Apharsathchites = “I will divide the deceivers (?)”

forms.meaning: “as causers of division (?)” Apharsathchites = “I will divide the deceivers (?)”
